models.name: Kronvex Nano-135M (Browser Ready)
models.tagline: Ultra-lightweight instant-download chat model that runs 100% inside your browser on your own PC.
models.description: Designed for immediate local experimentation right inside the KRONVEX Browser Chat Studio. Downloads directly into your browser cache (~140 MB quantized ONNX) and executes via WebGPU or WebAssembly with zero cloud server cost.

runCommands.python:
from transformers import pipeline
pipe = pipeline("text-generation", model="HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-135M-Instruct")

models.name: Kronvex Pulse-360M (Browser Ready)
models.tagline: Balanced low-latency local chat model delivering stronger reasoning directly in the browser.
models.description: A sweet-spot compact model that balances rapid download size (~240 MB) with noticeably richer multi-turn dialogue and summarization — executing 100% locally on your CPU or WebGPU.

runCommands.python:
from transformers import pipeline
pipe = pipeline("text-generation", model="HuggingFaceTB/SmolLM2-360M-Instruct")

models.name: Kronvex Edge-0.5B Instruct (Browser Ready)
models.tagline: Sharp instruction-following compact model runnable directly inside your browser via WebGPU/WASM.
models.description: High-capability compact instruction model capable of structured reasoning, JSON formatting, and technical Q&A entirely on the visitor’s local PC. Cached locally after first load.

runCommands.python:
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
model_id = "Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct"

models.name: Kronvex Coder-0.5B (Browser Ready)
models.tagline: Dedicated local code-generation and debugging assistant runnable straight inside your browser.
models.description: Specialized for TypeScript, Python, SQL, and shell scripting directly inside your browser tab. Downloads once into your local browser cache (~390 MB) and assists offline with zero API keys.

models.name: Kronvex-Quant-7B (Qwen2.5-7B Base)
models.tagline: High-precision 7B local reasoning engine for quantitative research, structured finance, and macro synthesis.
models.description: Built on the Apache-2.0 Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct architecture for institutional finance literature analysis, volatility reasoning, and deterministic JSON synthesis. Download verified GGUF or Safetensors weights directly from Hugging Face Hub.

runCommands.python:
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen2.5-7B-Instruct")

models.name: Kronvex-Systems-3B (Qwen2.5-Coder-3B Base)
models.tagline: Fast local coding & architecture copilot tuned for TypeScript, Python, Flutter, and Rust systems.
models.description: Compact, deterministic code-generation and audit model built on Apache-2.0 Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct to run offline on developer laptops with high throughput and low memory overhead.

runCommands.python:
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("Qwen/Qwen2.5-Coder-3B-Instruct")

models.name: Kronvex-Apex-14B Reasoning (DeepSeek-R1-Distill)
models.tagline: Workstation-grade deep reasoning and deterministic multi-agent orchestration flagship model.
models.description: Powered by MIT-licensed DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B for complex multi-step systems architecture, high-stakes quantitative synthesis, and deep chain-of-thought reasoning on local workstation GPUs.

runCommands.python:
from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
model = AutoModelForCausalLM.from_pretrained("deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-R1-Distill-Qwen-14B")
